label: Wed 11 Nov 2026
headline: Today's sound headlines
lead: 30 new stories from 17 sound and audio news sources over the last 48 hours, including Sound On Sound, Production Expert, ProSoundWeb, FOH, TPi and 12 more. This edition is assembled automatically from the outlets' own feeds: titles and summaries are theirs, sorted into sections. Open a story for the full article.

items.title: Pulsar Audio Releases DigiTape, A Free Early Digital Tape Plugin
items.take: Pulsar Audio has released DigiTape, a free plugin combining two early 2000s digital tape algorithms with a modern interface and five tape types. Here are the details.

items.take: Captured in the same sessions that shaped Whitacre’s latest album, the new arrival combines an array of analogue synth sounds with pianos and warped choir recordings, delivering an ambient electronic sound palette that complements the existing Choir and Contrast libraries.

craft.body:
Free tools like Plug-in Bench and the new no-iLok Soft Limit make it a good week to clean your plugin folder. Keep a simple list of every plugin you use on paid work, with version, format, licence type and whether it is confirmed on your current OS.

Before an OS or DAW update, test the list on a spare machine or a cloned drive, and keep old installers and old versions until every live session has been printed or archived. A session that opens with missing plugins in front of a client costs more than any update saves.
craft.title: Audit plugins before the session, not during it
